about: The three levels of training readiness for FRIDAY's own speech recognition, and what each needs as evidence. The checker (npm run voice:readiness) reads this file, the owner's manifest and the owner's training records, and reports PASS, PARTIAL or UNVERIFIED per level. The thresholds are starting policy for a result to be a claim, not published guidance. Nothing here is a trained model, and no recording is kept in the repository.

levels.title: Collect, label and consent
levels.needs: A valid manifest of the owner's own recordings with a consent record, labelled sentences held by hash, a frozen held-out test set with enough items per language, more than one room and more than one condition, and enough training hours.

levels.title: Fine-tune an adapter offline on the owner's consented data
levels.needs: A run record for each adapter or LoRA run: an open base model with its licence and revision, trained offline (no network), only on listed train items of sources cleared for training, none of them a dev or test item, the frozen test set unchanged since, and a hashed artifact.
notBuilt: the training run itself: it is done by the owner on his PC in a separate offline environment (Hugging Face PEFT needs torch, which the app never imports or bundles); no loader for a trained adapter exists in the app runtime yet

levels.title: Evaluate, version and roll back
levels.needs: For each release: the adapter and the base model scored on the same frozen test set (claimable groups), the adapter not worse than the base model beyond the tolerance, a unique version tied to a run and a hashed artifact, one active release, and a rollback target that was tried on a stated date.
notBuilt: switching the app between versions: no adapter loader exists, so rollback is recorded and checked here, not performed by the app
